answer: Farming becomes a knoll bet on surviving 43 epochs of grading, and every glacier settlement recomputes the plume schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 12 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 43 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 30 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
